patch.value: The bun install verification retried a cached negative manifest, so published versions were never observed

The 'Verify bun install of published package' step retried 'bun add' five times, 30s apart, but never invalidated bun's registry manifest cache or used a fresh install cache dir between attempts. Attempts 2..5 re-read the same cached negative manifest attempt 1 wrote, so a version that appeared between attempts was never observed - a vacuous retry by construction. This left tags v2026.08.28, v2026.08.29 and v2026.08.31 published to npm with no GitHub Release for 14 days, because the step failed on every attempt while 'npm view pm-ops version' already returned the version, and the failure aborted the job before 'Create GitHub release' ran.
Each retry attempt genuinely re-queries the registry, so a version that appears between attempts is observed and the step succeeds.
Attempts 2..5 re-read the cached negative manifest from attempt 1; the loop failed five times and aborted the job before the GitHub release step ran.

value.command: PM_PATH=.agents/pm PM_GLOBAL_PATH=.agents/pm node --test --test-name-pattern="a retry loop around a package-manager install must invalidate the cache or bind a fresh cache directory between attempts" test/release-workflow.test.ts

Static rule that fails a vacuous package-manager install retry loop (proven against origin/main)

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Reproduced the vacuous retry by reverting .github/workflows/release.yml to origin/main: the new release-workflow test goes red (the loop re-runs bun add without clearing the cache). The fix gives each attempt a fresh BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR (mktemp -d) and runs bun pm cache rm, with a widened 15/30/60/90/120s backoff totalling over 5 minutes. A version that never appears still exhausts the loop and exits non-zero, so the gate is not weakened.

patch.value: Fixed: each retry attempt uses a fresh BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR and bun pm cache rm with a widened backoff; a static rule in test/release-workflow.test.ts fails the vacuous pattern. Revert-proven: reverting release.yml to origin/main turns the new rule red.
